title: Base-two ceiling logarithm of two
statement: The base-two ceiling logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: $\lceil\log_2 2\rceil=1$.
replaced:
The ceiling base-$2$ logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: $\lceil \log_2 2 \rceil = 1$, i.e.\
$\texttt{Nat.clog}\,2\,2 = 1$. This is a small numerical fact used in the
communication-complexity bounds of this module.
